predictions.headline: Sabres should outlast a shot-shy Flyers side
predictions.text: Buffalo Sabres to win the moneyline against the Philadelphia Flyers at KeyBank Center. Buffalo are 4-3-2 through nine games and have scored 27 goals while conceding 33, a 3.00 goals-per-game attack that dwarfs Philadelphia's 1.55. The Flyers are 2-6-3 and have managed only 17 goals in 11 games, despite beating Colorado 3-2 on 19 October. Buffalo winger Tage Thompson leads the club with five goals and Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen has three wins in net, while Philadelphia's Matvei Michkov has six. The model puts Buffalo at 65.4%, which is why this selection is graded high confidence.

facts.claim: Buffalo are 4-3-2 and have scored 27 and conceded 33 in nine games
Philadelphia are 2-6-3 with 17 goals in 11 games (1.55 per game)
Tage Thompson 5 goals, Luukkonen 3 wins, Michkov 6 goals

predictions.headline: Bruins' defensive record points to a home win over Nashville
predictions.text: Boston Bruins to win the moneyline when the Nashville Predators visit TD Garden. Boston sit at 7-2-1 after ten games, scoring 36 and conceding just 22, which works out at 2.20 goals against per game, comfortably better than Nashville's 2.75. The Predators are 3-2-3 and have found the net 23 times in eight outings. David Pastrnak has four goals and eight assists for Boston and Jeremy Swayman has already recorded six wins, while Roman Josi has eight assists and Ryan O'Reilly four goals for Nashville. Our model gives Boston a 65.3% chance.

facts.claim: Boston 7-2-1, 36 goals for, 22 against in 10 games
Nashville 3-2-3, 23 goals for, 22 against in 8 games
Pastrnak 4+8, Swayman 6 wins, Josi 8 assists, O'Reilly 4 goals

predictions.headline: Islanders' goaltending and defence make them a clear home favourite
predictions.text: New York Islanders to win the moneyline against the Los Angeles Kings at UBS Arena. The Islanders are 5-3-1 and have conceded only 19 goals in nine games, a 2.11 goals-against average, while scoring 27. Los Angeles have played just seven games, going 1-4-2, and have shipped 27 goals at 3.86 per game while scoring 17. Bo Horvat leads New York with five goals, Matthew Schaefer has eight assists and Ilya Sorokin has five wins; the Kings' leading scorer is Artemi Panarin with four. The model makes the Islanders a 71.2% favourite, the highest NHL probability on this slate.

facts.claim: NY Islanders 5-3-1, 27 goals for, 19 against in 9 games
Los Angeles 1-4-2 in 7 games, 17 for, 27 against
Horvat 5 goals, Schaefer 8 assists, Sorokin 5 wins, Panarin 4 goals

predictions.headline: Wild's scoring depth against Calgary's leaky defence
predictions.text: Minnesota Wild to win the moneyline in Calgary. Minnesota are 6-2-2 with 31 goals for and 25 against in ten games, while the Flames are 2-6-0 and have conceded 37 goals in eight, an ugly 4.62 per game, scoring only 17 themselves. Kirill Kaprizov has 11 goals already and Quinn Hughes 11 assists for the Wild, with Jesper Wallstedt recording six wins. Calgary's scoring leader is Morgan Frost on three, and Dustin Wolf has one win. The model still lands on 68.9% for Minnesota even after applying its 1.05 home-ice adjustment in Calgary's favour, and the gap in goals conceded is what drives that number rather than any market signal.

facts.claim: Kaprizov 11 goals, Quinn Hughes 11 assists, Wallstedt 6 wins, Frost 3 goals, Wolf 1 win
